crossRefs.note: God remembered Noah, all the animals, and all the livestock that were with him in the ship; and God made a wind to pass…
when he established the clouds above, when the springs of the deep became strong,
He awoke, and rebuked the wind, and said to the sea, “Peace! Be still!” The wind ceased, and there was a great calm.
The sea saw it, and fled. The Jordan was driven back.

translations.web: At your rebuke they fled. At the voice of your thunder they hurried away.
translations.bsb: At Your rebuke the waters fled; at the sound of Your thunder they hurried away—
translations.kjv: At thy rebuke they fled; at the voice of thy thunder they hasted
translations.asv: At thy rebuke they fled; At the voice of thy thunder they hasted away
